title: Interaction states, keyboard, motion — every interactive element
objective: Census every interactive element (links, buttons, inputs, accordions, menus, sortable headers, the sticky bar) and verify each one's full state set — default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled where applicable — plus keyboard traversal and motion behavior, at desktop-1440, tablet-834 and mobile-390. The design-choice half of the brief lives here: an interactive element with a missing or inconsistent state is a design defect even when it 'works'.

steps.do: Write _harness/audit10-interactives.js: per page (desktop-1440), enumerate a[href], button, [role=button], input, select, textarea, summary, [tabindex] — output plans/audit10/state/interactives.json: {url: [{selector, tag, text, box}]} (committed). This is the checklist the rest of the pass walks.

State sweep per element class (not per instance — group identical component classes, then verify EVERY class and spot-verify 3 instances per class): hover (mouse.move onto it; computed style delta must exist for pointer-affordant elements), focus-visible (REAL Tab key — Chromium will not match :focus-visible on programmatic focus; the indicator must be visible and >= 3:1 against its ground per plan4's convention), active where styled. Record classes with NO hover delta and NO focus indicator as findings; record INCONSISTENT treatments (two button classes, one with focus ring one without) as C.

Keyboard-only traversal at desktop-1440: Tab from address bar through each of the 10 routes end-to-end. Order sane (matches visual order; the contact-desktop-focus-order exception is DECIDED — known_issues), nothing unreachable, nothing trapped, skip-link if present works, mega-menus operable (open/navigate/Escape), FAQ accordions toggle on Enter/Space, /dashboard sort headers operate and announce (aria-sort moves).

Overlay/menu behavior: mobile menu at 390 (open, Tab-cycle containment or documented non-containment, Escape, body scroll behavior while open), mega-menu hover-vs-click at 834 (touch-class viewport: hover-only opening is a B if click does not also work — measured, not assumed; the 'mega-menus broken on touch' claim was REFUTED before, so evidence must be new and specific).

Motion: (a) default: the sticky RFQ bar slide-in, hero animation, FAQ collapse — each runs once, settles, no infinite churn (rAF/transition loops measured over 10s idle); (b) prefers-reduced-motion: emulate and re-check the same set — plan8-motion covers a known list; verify anything NEW pass-1/2 flagged; (c) transition orphans: elements with transition styles that never fire or that fire on page load (flash of animation on first paint).

Scroll behaviors: anchor deep-links (C30 industry anchors) land with the target visible below the sticky navbar (scroll-margin), back/forward restores position sanely, scrollIntoView calls (sidebar onNavigate) behave at each viewport.

Forms interaction: /contact — field focus states, error appearance timing (on submit vs on blur — consistency is the subject), error focus management (documented behavior: focus moves to the alert — re-verify), the honeypot is invisible AND unfocusable by Tab.

Record findings (missing state on a conversion-path element -> B; inconsistent state treatment -> C; single-element nits -> batched D), resolve pass-6 candidates, validate, ledger, commit 'audit10(pass-6): ...', push, delete mirror credential.

scope_fences: plan8-keyboard/plan8-motion/plan4 cover a known-green set — your job is what they DON'T cover plus consistency across classes; re-run them once to confirm still-green rather than re-deriving their assertions
no new-interaction proposals; absence-of-affordance is only a finding where a user cannot complete or perceive an existing function
exit_criteria: every component class state-swept with counts in ledger
keyboard traversal notes for all 10 routes
